verdict.rationale: Attio explicitly documents natural-language control via AI: connecting Claude/ChatGPT to search, update and manage the workspace, an official MCP server, and AI features to search/update/create records and build workflows just by describing goals. This directly matches the story of operating the product via natural-language commands, though evidence is vendor-documented without independent hands-on verification. missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of natural-language command reliability, and depth on limits/edge cases of NL command coverage.
